name: Paul R. Genender
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Dallas, Texas
about: Paul Genender is a Business Litigation attorney working in Dallas, Texas. Paul Genender assists clients with Antitrust Litigation and Intellectual Property Litigation issues. Paul Genender works as an attorney at Paul Hastings LLP.
As one of a small number of attorneys selected to Super Lawyers, Paul Genender gained this recognition through professional achievement, peer recognition, and other distinguishing criteria.
He graduated from Duke University School of Law in 1994.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
